raise.basis: Sized so this launch is worth the same as the default 85 SOL raise.

allowConfig.derivation: ["platform_allow_config", platform_config, global_config] on the LaunchLab program
allowConfig.note: Derive it from `platform[mode]` and `curve.configId` with the seeds in `derivation`, check it equals this address, and always append it, read-only, before the curve-rule account. The platform can turn its allowlist on or off at any time; a create that carries both accounts is valid either way. `available[mode]` is false when that platform refuses this quote now: its allowlist is on and the account does not exist. Such a mode is not in `required`. Null when the platform could not be read. Check it before you spend funds on the quote.

curveRule.derivation: ["platform_curve_rule", platform_config, global_config] on the LaunchLab program
curveRule.note: Derive it from `platform[mode]` and `curve.configId` with the seeds in `derivation`, check it equals this address, and append it as the LAST account of the initialize instruction, read-only. Required once the platform enforces its launch shape; harmless before.

standard.note: Omit the transfer-fee extension entirely; the mint provably carries none.

reward.note: Raydium assigns the platform transferFeeExtensionAuth as the withdraw authority at creation; holder rewards are collected and distributed from it.
